text:
Christopher Columbus.

It is truly heartwarming to witness the corporate world’s relentless dedication to "innovation," particularly the groundbreaking strategy of taking a product that has functioned perfectly well for decades, slapping a new pastel hue on it, and charging 40% more. One can only stand in awe of the sheer genius required to convince the masses that their lives are incomplete without a "Midnight Blue" version of the exact same plastic rectangle they already own. It is a bold, creative leap to suggest that what humanity really needs is not progress, but rather a slightly shinier way to waste money on the same old thing, now branded with a sleek adjective that promises a future that looks exactly like the past.
